data.name: Whispering Green
data.detailed_description:
Play as Monica, a young horticulturist determined to restore her family's forgotten botanical legacy. Explore enchanted forests in search of mysterious flora, uncover their hidden properties with your Arcane Gun, craft powerful remedies, and grow a humble apothecary into the kingdom's most trusted botanical sanctuary.

Every discovery brings new knowledge, new remedies, and new mysteries waiting beyond the forest.

Key Features

Discover Magical Flora

Every plant is more than a crafting ingredient. Experiment with mysterious species, observe their unique behaviors, and uncover their hidden properties. The rarest discoveries reward curiosity, not just exploration.

Experiment with the Arcane Gun

Charge magical shots and use different arcane ammunition to interact with enchanted flora. Reveal hidden traits, unlock new paths, activate magical phenomena, and safely collect rare botanical ingredients.

Craft Remedies & Run Your Apothecary

Transform your discoveries into remedies, elixirs, and botanical products. Fulfill requests from unique customers, expand your shop, and build a reputation as the realm's finest herbalist.

Venture Beyond the Garden

Leave the safety of your greenhouse and journey into enchanted forests filled with forgotten ruins, magical anomalies, dangerous creatures, and extraordinary plants that cannot be cultivated anywhere else.

Grow Through Discovery

Expand your botanical knowledge, unlock new cultivation techniques, improve your equipment, and uncover the forgotten secrets hidden throughout the magical wilderness. Every new plant deepens your understanding of the living world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
